verdict.rationale: Goodwin's own venture practice page says its fund formation attorneys help clients raise 'domestic and international funds', and the firm lists offices across North America, Europe and Asia (London, Munich, Paris, Luxembourg, Hong Kong, Singapore). That is a thin, glancing signal of cross-border venture work. Its startup tooling (Document Driver) forms only Delaware entities, and nothing in the evidence describes flips, redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction company financings. Missing for 10: documented flip/redomiciliation work, documented multi-jurisdiction startup financings, international-investor deal representation on the company side, and independent corroboration such as deal lists or case studies.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm documents cross-border venture work — international investors, flips/redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings

citations.quote: Our VC Fund Formation attorneys help clients raise domestic and international funds ranging from less than $25 million to over $10 billion.
Our lawyers and business professionals operate from 18 offices across North America, Europe, and Asia
